title: Luxury Wine Tours to Niagara On The Lake
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The VIP Wine Tour to Niagara is a private tour with pick up at private residences, hotels or business. It includes a 90 minute drive in a comfortable vehicle with chauffeur/guide to Niagara, one of the new world wine regions. Included in the tour are visits to three of the finest, award winning wineries in the Region with private wine tastings at each. The tour includes flights of wine at some of Niagara's wonderful, small boutique wineries and magnificent large estate wineries. A three course lunch is included at a local favorite restaurant featuring fresh Mediterranean cuisine or at a renowned winery restaurant in the town of Niagara On The Lake. Touring through one of Canada's prettiest towns and past impressive estates is also part of the tour. The tour includes pick up at 9.15 a.m. and return at approximately 5.30 p.m.
A stop at the one of the wonders of the world, Niagara Falls, can be
part of a package.
